title: The Tenth Coat Was Dry
story: The theatre locked with nine coats and opened with ten. The extra coat was dry, though rain had fallen all evening, and its pocket held no ticket stub. Cameras watched the lobby but not the side aisle. A programme from the later act lay on a seat sold as empty. Rafi decided the visit had been chosen, not forced by the weather.

vocabulary.definition: One more than there should have been
The small torn remainder of a ticket
The entrance hall of the theatre
The side passage between the seats
The printed sheet describing the performance
Decided on purpose rather than by chance

quiz.question: How many coats were there when the theatre opened?
options: Ten
Nine
One dry ticket stub
None in the side aisle
quiz.explanation: The theatre opened with ten coats.
quiz.supportingSentence: The theatre locked with nine coats and opened with ten.

quiz.question: What did the extra coat’s pocket not contain?
options: A ticket stub
A dry lining
A seam along the edge
A button at the cuff
quiz.explanation: Its pocket held no ticket stub.
quiz.supportingSentence: The extra coat was dry, though rain had fallen all evening, and its pocket held no ticket stub.

quiz.question: Why did a soaked latecomer seem unlikely?
options: The extra coat had stayed dry through an evening of rain
The lobby cameras showed a very wet ticket
The empty seat was outdoors in the storm
Rafi had dried the coat before the doors opened
quiz.correctAnswer: The extra coat had stayed dry through an evening of rain
quiz.explanation: A person driven in by the rain would likely be wet, but the extra coat was dry.
quiz.supportingSentence: The extra coat was dry, though rain had fallen all evening, and its pocket held no ticket stub.

quiz.question: What is a stub in this passage?
options: The small remainder of a used ticket
A dry coat left in the lobby
A seat that had been sold as empty
A camera above the side aisle
quiz.correctAnswer: The small remainder of a used ticket
quiz.explanation: A ticket stub would be the leftover part of a ticket, and the pocket held none.
quiz.supportingSentence: The extra coat was dry, though rain had fallen all evening, and its pocket held no ticket stub.

quiz.question: Why does the writer mention that the cameras missed the side aisle?
options: To show one way in was not being watched
To prove the lobby stayed closed all evening
To suggest the programme was being filmed
To argue that coats should be banned
quiz.correctAnswer: To show one way in was not being watched
quiz.explanation: Cameras on the lobby but not the side aisle leave an unwatched route into the theatre.
quiz.supportingSentence: Cameras watched the lobby but not the side aisle.
